SELECT SEQ_PATRIT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TBL_PATRIT (PATRIT_NUM, CONTENT, REG_DATE, TEAM_NUM, USER_ID) VALUES (#{patritNum}, #{content}, SYSDATE, #{teamNum}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT P.PATRIT_NUM, P.CONTENT, P.REG_DATE, P.TEAM_NUM, U.USER_ID, CASE WHEN U.NAME IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN LENGTH(U.NAME) = 1 THEN U.NAME WHEN LENGTH(U.NAME) = 2 THEN SUBSTR(U.NAME, 1, 1) || 'O' ELSE SUBSTR(U.NAME, 1, 1) || RPAD('O', LENGTH(U.NAME) - 1, 'O') END AS NAME, U.AUTHORITY FROM TBL_PATRIT P JOIN TBL_USER U ON P.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE P.PATRIT_NUM = #{value}
SELECT YEAR, TERM FROM ( SELECT YEAR, TERM FROM TBL_TEAM ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(YEAR) DESC, TO_NUMBER(TERM) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT DISTINCT YEAR, TERM FROM TBL_TEAM ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(YEAR) DESC, TO_NUMBER(TERM) DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_TEAM T JOIN TBL_TEAM_MEMBER TM ON TM.TEAM_NUM = T.TEAM_NUM JOIN TBL_PATRIT P ON P.TEAM_NUM = TM.TEAM_NUM AND P.USER_ID = TM.USER_ID WHERE T.YEAR = #{year} AND T.TERM = #{term}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS RNUM, A.* FROM ( SELECT P.PATRIT_NUM, P.CONTENT, P.REG_DATE, P.TEAM_NUM, U.USER_ID, CASE WHEN U.NAME IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN LENGTH(U.NAME) = 1 THEN U.NAME WHEN LENGTH(U.NAME) = 2 THEN SUBSTR(U.NAME, 1, 1) || 'O' ELSE SUBSTR(U.NAME, 1, 1) || RPAD('O', LENGTH(U.NAME) - 1, 'O') END AS NAME, U.AUTHORITY FROM TBL_TEAM T JOIN TBL_TEAM_MEMBER TM ON TM.TEAM_NUM = T.TEAM_NUM JOIN TBL_PATRIT P ON P.TEAM_NUM = TM.TEAM_NUM AND P.USER_ID = TM.USER_ID JOIN TBL_USER U ON U.USER_ID = P.USER_ID WHERE T.YEAR = #{year} AND T.TERM = #{term} ORDER BY P.PATRIT_NUM DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{pageEnd} ) WHERE RNUM >= #{pageStart} ORDER BY PATRIT_NUM DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT T.TEAM_NUM AS teamNum, T.TEAM_NAME AS teamName, T.YEAR AS year, T.TERM AS term, U.USER_ID AS userId, U.AUTHORITY AS authority FROM TBL_USER U JOIN TBL_TEAM_MEMBER TM ON TM.USER_ID = U.USER_ID JOIN TBL_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_NUM = TM.TEAM_NUM WHERE U.USER_ID = #{value} ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(T.YEAR) DESC, TO_NUMBER(T.TERM) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
